support_rule: Five matched positive/negative Pangram pairs appended as in-context references to advisor seeds. Whole support groups excluded from search and screening; support never comes from dev or fresh test.
inference: strict single text, same core.predict settings for every stage
objective: 0.5 overall balanced accuracy +0.5 mean per-length balanced accuracy on strata with both classes; provider refusal counts as error
selection: Screen three advisor proposals and previous prompt on fixed training screen; best starts Shinka. After eight attempted generations compare previous prompt and best training candidate on reused dev. Freeze winner before fresh test. Old test is now training, no longer held out.
order_check: Before Shinka, compare normal and reversed within-pair support order on training screen. Diagnostic only; it does not change selected seed or decision objective.
termination: At most eight generations in active run, or stop when the fixed full training objective reaches its mathematical maximum 1.0. Added before any perfect result; selection and fresh test unchanged.
fresh_test_addition: Added 12 human+AI sentence mixes before any fresh teacher labels or classifier predictions; same source groups, no new source overlap. Fresh total 142 after dedup.
